## PR Self-Check Result

Note first: PR #367 is already **merged** (merge commit `9bbe3c0`, merged 2026-08-20T05:19:22Z) — it landed before this self-check was invoked, and main already contains its changes. The review below is retrospective/informational rather than a pre-merge gate.

### Fix
None.

### Note
- [Necessary] Bullets 9 and 19 in "Key changes" spell out what each newly added rule requires (e.g. "in a bulleted section the top level carries the change or claim itself..."), which is close to the case the rule these bullets describe now forbids ("spelling out what an added rule, definition, or table row says is detail, whether quoted, summarized, or given with its consequence"). Plausible exception applies: for a PR whose diff *is* a rules file, a reviewer likely can't judge the design decision without seeing what the added rules say, so this may be the "shape of the decision" Decidable requires rather than diff paraphrase. Flagged because the checker isn't fully confident this reads as a defect rather than a legitimate exception.

### Unverifiable
None — every checkable claim in the body had a primary source reachable from this working tree (git history at the merge base, and the gitignored `ikuwowfiles/pr-guidelines-reformat-check.md` file, present locally).

### Property walk
- Decidable: title and body clearly state the two new rules, the reformat, the severity collapse, and the four bounded rules, in a structure a reviewer can approve/reject from top-down.
- Grounded: all four checked claims held up — the "45 top-level, 0 nested, largest of 17 files" count matches `git show b9256e4:...` exactly (b9256e4 is the actual merge base, one commit behind current `main`), the "37 rule bullets" count matches the row count in the cited local verification file, and both `Grounded`-rule-wording claims (evidence-inclusion sense, primary-source rule standing alone) match the merge-base text verbatim.
- Necessary: mostly holds; see the Note above on self-referential tension with the rule this PR itself adds.
- Scoped: all three changed files (`git-workflow/SKILL.md`, `pr-guidelines.md`, `pr-selfcheck/SKILL.md`) sit inside the stated intent, including the severity-tier collapse, which the body ties back to the altitude rule (no more double-counting a bullet-count defect).
- Conformant: no hard-wrap violations found in the body (checked against the parser spec); checkbox usage, title, and language all conform; no stale "Must Fix"/"Should Fix"/"Nice to Have" references remain anywhere under `claude/` post-merge.

### Verdict
PASS

Verification notes (for reference, not part of the PR body):
- Bullet counts at merge base `b9256e4` (`git -C /Users/ikuwow/dotfiles show b9256e4:<file> | grep -c '^- '` / `'^ \+- '`): `pr-guidelines.md` = 45 top / 0 nested, the largest flat list among the 17 files under `claude/rules/` and `claude/skills/` — matches the body's claim.
- `/Users/ikuwow/dotfiles/ikuwowfiles/pr-guidelines-reformat-check.md` has exactly 37 `| <line-number>` mapping rows and a "Result" section stating every clause landed at exactly one destination — matches the Verification checklist's claim.
- No `Must Fix`/`Should Fix`/`Nice to Have` strings remain anywhere under `claude/` at the PR head (`git grep` on `FETCH_HEAD`).

tool_input.command:
cd /Users/ikuwow/dotfiles
git fetch origin pull/367/head -q
git ls-tree -r --name-only main -- claude/rules claude/skills

cd /Users/ikuwow/dotfiles
for f in $(git ls-tree -r --name-only main -- claude/rules claude/skills); do
  top=$(git show main:"$f" | grep -c '^- ')
  nested=$(git show main:"$f" | grep -c '^ \+- ')
  echo "$f top=$top nested=$nested"
done

git -C /Users/ikuwow/dotfiles log -1 --oneline main
git -C /Users/ikuwow/dotfiles show main:claude/skills/git-workflow/pr-guidelines.md | sed -n '30,70p'
